title: OpenCV 3.0.0 through 4.14.0 and 5.0.0 through 5.1.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the built-in MJPEG…
description: OpenCV versions 3.0.0 through 4.14.0 and 5.0.0 through 5.1.0 have an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the built-in MJPEG encoder when processing grayscale frames. This occurs due to incorrect level shifting in the convertToYUV() function, which can cause unchecked lookups in cat_table and huff_dc_tab. Exploitation can lead to leaking adjacent or uninitialized memory into the output file or cause the process to crash.
